title: An inverse free boundary problem
summary: We study inverse problems for the elliptic and parabolic obstacle problems from boundary measurements. For the classical elliptic obstacle problem with strictly superharmonic obstacle function, we show that the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map admits a one-sided linearization at every boundary datum lying strictly above the obstacle. The linearized map is the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a rough Dirichlet problem on the a priori unknown non-contact set.
